title: SQLite WAL (Write-Ahead Log) signature
summary: A SQLite Write-Ahead Log file begins with the 8-byte magic 0x37 0x7F 0x06 0x82 0x83 0x88 0x6F 0xF7 (big-endian) or 0x37 0x7F 0x06 0x83 (the salt follows).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Followed by file format version (3007000), page size, checkpoint sequence, salt-1, salt-2, checksum-1, checksum-2.
WAL mode allows concurrent readers with a single writer.
The -wal file is checkpointed into the main .db file periodically.
